field.label: Enable DNS synchronisation
field.help: Publishes private Pangolin resource aliases reported by the machine client into an os-pangolin-owned Unbound include file. Public domains are never rewritten and manually managed Unbound entries are never modified or deleted. Unbound access control is left unchanged: only clients already allowed to query Unbound can use these records.

field.label: Reconciliation interval
field.help: State changes trigger an immediate sync through the agent hook. This interval is a periodic safety net (for example after a crash or a missed event).

field.label: Record TTL
field.help: TTL in seconds for generated local-data records.

field.label: Enable conditional forwarding
field.help: Optionally forward the listed private DNS suffixes to the machine client's internal DNS proxy. This is only needed when the deployment uses a private Pangolin resolver zone; static alias records work without it.

field.label: Conditional-forward domains
field.help: Comma-separated private DNS suffixes, without wildcards. Queries for these suffixes are forwarded to the tunnel DNS proxy; all other queries continue to use normal Unbound resolution.

field.label: Managed file
field.help: The plugin writes /usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d/os-pangolin.conf only. OPNsense copies this include into the Unbound chroot on restart. Remove the plugin or disable DNS sync to remove the file; manual host/domain overrides are checked for conflicts and take precedence.
